plan.summary: inma tarafı henüz hazır olmadığı için LoginPage'e 3 test butonu ekleniyor (Tam Yetkili, Demo Klinik, Demo Otel). Backend'de InmaAuth:MockEnabled=true gated POST /api/v1/inma/auth/mock-login endpoint'i eklendi — inma proxy'si bypass edilerek doğrudan inse JWT üretir. Frontend: api.ts mockLogin(), useAuth.ts loginWithMock(), LoginPage.tsx test butonları.
plan.q_intent: iki üç tane login düğmesi ekle test için. bunlara basında sanki inma tarafından firma adı, kullanıcı adı ve tüm InseFeatures izinli gelsin.
plan.interview_notes: inma side not ready. Need mock endpoint gated by InmaAuth:MockEnabled. 3 scenarios: full (all features), klinik (Appointments/Knowledge/Analytics), otel (FlowBuilder/Knowledge/Outbound/Marketing). All use tenant_id=1.

verification_questions.question: Is the mock endpoint properly gated by InmaAuth:MockEnabled flag and returns 503 when disabled?
Does the mock endpoint handle malformed/empty JSON body gracefully (JsonException catch)?
Does loginWithMock in useAuth.ts follow the same error handling pattern as loginWithInma (typed catch, clearSession on failure)?
Are the 3 test buttons only visible in 'inma' mode and disabled during loading?
Does the mock endpoint response shape exactly match InmaAuthResponse so api.setSession() works unchanged?
